traits: Cap 3 to 10 cm, convex to conical, slightly nippled, reddish-brown and paler at the centre
Gills spaced, whitish-pink, staining rusty red
Stem 8 to 14 cm, swollen in the middle and tapering at both ends, rooting, deeply grooved, reddish-brown to blackish below, no ring
Firm whitish flesh, mild sweet taste
In clumps on broadleaf stumps, mostly oak · summer to autumn
safetyNote: Toxic: the DGfM lists it for a gastrointestinal syndrome. The sources read disagree: Wikipedia (fr) calls it fairly good if only very young caps are eaten, with the tough stem removed, and warns that late harvests cause indigestion; Wikipedia (en) says most authors do not think it worth a meal and that old ones risk gastro-enteritis. The most prudent status, the DGfM one, is kept. Wikipedia (fr) says beginners may take it for a pholiota, a hypholoma or an honey fungus; it has no ring and a grooved spindle stem.

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Liste der Giftpilze mit Syndromen, sortiert nach Taxa, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
